html:
An economist who became president of Liberia in January 2006, the first woman elected head of state in Africa, and served two terms until 2018.

She had been finance minister under Tolbert, was jailed by Samuel Doe and worked for the World Bank and the UN. Elected after the civil wars, she won the cancellation of most of Liberia's foreign debt, brought back electricity to Monrovia and led the country through the Ebola epidemic. Critics pointed to corruption and her early support for Charles Taylor. She shared the Nobel Peace Prize in 2011. In 2018 she handed power to George Weah, Liberia's first peaceful transfer between elected leaders since 1944.
sum: An economist who became president of Liberia in January 2006, the first woman elected head of state in Africa, and served two terms until 2018.
